topology_reasoning.device_identification: A symmetric four-port orthogonal waveguide crossing. Four narrow single-mode access guides expand into leaf-shaped adiabatic crossing lobes and meet in one shared central material region.
topology_reasoning.operating_principle: Each input expands smoothly before the intersection so the optical mode crosses the orthogonal guide with reduced diffraction and reflection, then contracts back to the narrow output guide. Fourfold rotational symmetry makes either straight-through axis equivalent.
function_defining_knobs: guide_width: width of all four single-mode access guides
access_length: straight narrow lead length at each edge
outer_taper_length: length of the narrow-to-wide adiabatic expansion
crossing_max_width: maximum lobe width that controls modal expansion
inner_taper_length: contraction length from maximum width toward the shared crossing
center_width: width presented by each axis at the central overlap

measured_image_observations.symmetry: approximately fourfold about the footprint center

iterations.change_made: Identified and corrected reversed radial assembly: move the center-width end to the shared crossing, then expand to maximum width, contract to guide width, and finish with the narrow outer access.
